pr_title: fix: ioctl use /dev/tty instead of fd 0 for VT_GETSTATE
pr_body:
ioctl VT_GETSTATE on stdin fails if it is not console, such as when using GDM.  `/dev/tty` should be used instead.

- `/dev/tty` is a synonym for the controlling terminal of a process, if there is one.

---

Fixes #2460

issue_context.title: If started with GDM, pressing ctrl-alt-f<vt number of Hyprland> will freeze Hyprland.
issue_context.body:
## Steps to reproduce

1. Launch Hyprland session from GDM.
2. Get current vt number with `fgconsole`, e.g. 3
3. press <kbd>ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>alt</kbd>+<kbd>f3<kbd>
4. Hyprland freezes

## Notes

Cannot be reproduced in `sway` and `gnome-shell`.
Can be reproduced in a virtual machine using `virgl`.
Can be reproduced in a clean arch install using default configuration.
comments: I am not sure if this is a GDM bug because mutter, kwin and other wlroots compositors like sway, cage do not behave like this when started with GDM.
This is also reproducible with ly tui display manager
can someone ssh into a frozen session like this and show the stacktrace of the hang?

https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/blob/4986d74ef201171a930c312a8e3b72a22d9b84ee/src/managers/KeybindManager.cpp#L520-L524

In a hyprland session started from GDM, fd **0** is `/dev/null', thus ioctl VT_GETACTIVE fails with `inappropriate ioctl for device' when using **0** as `fields'.

As the ioctl failed, the ttynum remains 0.

https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/blob/4986d74ef201171a930c312a8e3b72a22d9b84ee/src/managers/KeybindManager.cpp#L531-L540

`ttynum == TTY` will evaluate to true even if `TTY` is the VT number of Hyprland, causing `g_pCompositor->m_bSessionActive = false`, effectively disabling both keybinding handling and graphical updates.
